height.description: Height of the visualization in pixels

pdb_content.description: Raw PDB file content as string. Either pdb_id or pdb_content must be provided.

width.description: Width of the visualization in pixels

result.description: Comprehensive protein structure quality assessment and protein-ligand complex profiling using StructureProfiler. Performs thorough validation of protein structures including geometry checks, stereochemistry analysis, clash detection, and ligand binding site quality assessment. Supports multiple validation settings: 'astex' (Astex diverse set criteria), 'iridium' (Iridium validation), 'platinum' (PlatinumQuality set), or 'combined' (comprehensive analysis). Returns detailed quality reports covering protein structure integrity, active site geometry, ligand binding quality, and structural anomalies. Essential for validating structures before molecular modeling, identifying potential artifacts, and ensuring reliability of structure-based drug design results. Example: Use 'combined' setting on 1KZK to assess overall structure quality before docking studies.
result.name: ProteinsPlus_profile_structure_quality

setting.description: Validation setting: 'astex' (Astex diverse set criteria), 'iridium' (Iridium validation rules), 'platinum' (PlatinumQuality standards), or 'combined' (all checks). Default: 'combined'. Example: Use 'combined' for thorough validation, 'astex' for docking benchmark standards.

result.description: Add hydrogens and optimize protonation states of a protein-ligand complex using ProtoSS (Protonation Structure Solver) on ProteinsPlus. ProtoSS places hydrogen atoms, assigns tautomers and protonation states, and optimizes the hydrogen-bond network of the protein and any co-crystallized ligands. Protonation is the standard prerequisite step before molecular docking, interaction-fingerprint analysis, or binding-energy calculations, because raw PDB structures lack hydrogen positions. Input a PDB ID (or raw PDB content). Returns URLs to the protonated protein (PDB), protonated ligand(s) (SDF), and a log file. Example: pdbCode '1cbs' returns protein=.../1cbs.pdb (protonated), ligands=.../1cbs.sdf, log=.../1cbs_log.txt.
result.name: ProteinsPlus_protonate_structure

ligand_content.description: Optional raw ligand SDF content to protonate alongside the protein. Only used with pdb_content uploads.

pdb_content.description: Raw PDB file content as a string (multi-line text). Use either pdb_id or pdb_content, not both.

pdb_id.description: PDB identifier (e.g., '1cbs', '1KZK', '4HHB'). Use either pdb_id or pdb_content, not both.
